objective.statement: Change the border colour of the bordered div in HomeView.tsx from red to green.

complexity.rationale: One localized Tailwind class change in a single view; no contracts, state or approval-boundary work.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The bordered div in HomeView.tsx has a green border and no longer has a red border.

in.statement: src/views/home/HomeView.tsx and its colocated component test.

out.statement: Renaming the aria-label, test-id key or test titles that still say red; size, text or other views.

observations.statement: "Green" is taken as Tailwind border-green-500, mirroring the existing border-red-500 shade.

component.rationale: Border class is rendered component behaviour.

integration.rationale: No cross-module flow change; npm run test run as regression.

e2e.rationale: Static styling with no user flow.

increments.behavior: The HomeView bordered div uses border-green-500 instead of border-red-500.
increments.doneWhen: t-1 passes and the full suite stays green.

tests.description: HomeView bordered div has border-green-500 and not border-red-500.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: Div class contains border-red-500, not border-green-500.
expectedRedEvidence.observedFailure: 1 of 4 tests failed: expected className to contain border-green-500; received border-red-500.

verification.requirement: npm run test, npm run lint and npm run build pass.
verification.command: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
verification.result: 8/8 tests pass (3 files), lint clean, build ok
